chunks: And it was narrated: that al-Sadiq عليه السلام gave a man thirty dinars and said to him
"Perform hajj on behalf of Isma'il, and do this and that, and nine are for you while one is for him."

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلَ: Isma'il, the person on whose behalf the hajj is to be performed
key_terms.الصَّادِقَ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker in this report
key_terms.تِسْعٌ: nine shares mentioned for the performer
key_terms.ثَلَاثِينَ دِينَارًا: thirty dinars, the payment given for the delegated act

ai.seo_question: Can someone perform hajj on behalf of another person and share in the reward?
ai.summary: This report describes Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام appointing someone to perform hajj on behalf of Isma'il and giving him payment for that task. It indicates the permissibility of deputizing hajj and mentions a distribution of reward between the agent and the one on whose behalf the hajj is performed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2876 - It was narrated that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) gave a man thirty dinars and said to him:
"Perform Hajj on behalf of Isma'il, and do this and that, and you shall have nine [portions of reward], while he shall have one."
